trypanosomiasis_resistance.Major_Finding: Identified 18 chromosome regions (BTA2, BTA7, BTA14) controlling anaemia and parasitaemia control.
Selective sweep at TICAM1 and TLR signaling loci; indigenous West African taurines possess unique ancestral haplotypes.
Hemoglobin polymorphisms and cytokine expression profile contribute to mild parasitaemia without severe wasting.

heat_tolerance_cattle.Major_Finding: PRLR (Prolactin Receptor) slick hair gene mutation lowers core body temperature by 0.5-0.8°C under severe heat stress.
HSP70 and HSP90 upregulation enhances cellular cytoprotection during peak solar radiation periods.
Adaptive introgressions linked to water conservation (aquaporins) and cutaneous evaporation in Sahelian cattle.

maize_drought_tolerance.Major_Finding: TZE-W Pop x TZE-Y Pop showed shortest anthesis-silking interval (ASI < 2.5 days) and 35% higher yield under moisture stress.
Significant QTL on chromosome 1 and 8 correlated with functional stay-green and prolonged photosynthesis during grain filling.

poultry_bioclimatics.Major_Finding: Stocking density reduction to 8–10 birds/m² combined with night feeding lowered heat mortality from 14.2% to 2.8%.
Supplementation with 1g/L Vitamin C and 0.2% sodium bicarbonate restored blood pH and egg shell thickness during peak afternoon panting.
Lasota booster at Day 28 following Day 14 vaccination maintained protective antibody titers (>4 log2) across Harmattan dust periods.

rabbit_cuniculture.Major_Finding: Wilting Tridax procumbens for 4–6 hours reduced tympany/bloat incidence by 92% and improved cecal fiber digestion.

rabbit_cuniculture.Population: New Zealand White x Chinchilla (NAPRI Zaria)
rabbit_cuniculture.Major_Finding: NZW buck x Chinchilla doe cross demonstrated superior heterosis with 7.2 kits/litter and 88% weaning survival under northern savanna heat.
Temperatures exceeding 28°C caused severe oligospermia and temporary buck sterility lasting 6 to 8 weeks post-exposure.

tomato_horticulture.Major_Finding: Cobra 26 F1 and Tropimech exhibited lowest fruit cracking (<5%) and highest bacterial wilt tolerance across humid southwestern Nigeria.
Pyramiding Ty-1 and Ty-3 resistance alleles conferred complete field protection against Begomovirus transmission by Bemisia tabaci.
Split application of Calcium Nitrate (50 kg/ha) or foliar Calcium-Boron chelate eradicated Blossom End Rot on acidic soils.

cassava_genomics.Major_Finding: Mapped major dominant resistance loci CMD2 on Chromosome 12 and CMD3 on Chromosome 14 explaining 65% of phenotypic variance.

cassava_genomics.Trait: Dry Matter Content & Fresh Root Yield
cassava_genomics.Major_Finding: TME 419 and TMS 98/0505 achieved high dry matter stability (>32%) across multiple agro-ecological zones.

rice_submergence.Major_Finding: Introgression of Sub1A QTL into FARO 44 background enabled complete survival under 14 days of full submergence.
Deep placement of urea briquettes at 7–10 cm depth reduced nitrogen volatilization by 38% and elevated grain yield by 1.2 t/ha.
